scope: Descriptive paired assessment on the original 256 S1 training teachers; no held-out or route-quality claim
selection: All 256 original teachers, in index order, all saved teacher-prefix decisions, both fixed endpoints for each seed; no checkpoint selection
tie_break: Lowest local candidate index; exact equality ties
teacher_forcing: Each environment advances only by the saved teacher action; predicted alternatives are scored but never executed
conservative_combined_guard: min(900, 1800 - largest_completed_seed_stage_wall_s); diagnostics remain separately accounted and do not extend any scientific training budget
interpretation: Training-set imitation and numerical/lineage readiness only. No evidence of new-scene generalization, complete-route improvement or DRL benefit. S2 and S3 remain unauthorized.
